note: Each final-stage invocation is identified separately; request ledgers also include preserved earlier development pilots.

holdout_decision.reason: Source-only QA already found duplicated atomic scoring goals in approved development rubrics 03 and 05. Preserve holdout because source validity has not passed; finish the frozen development experiment without further semantic revision.

judgment_exit_meaning: All planned calls and reports completed; two combined assessments retain independent content disagreement.

shared_content_findings.meaning: Shared positive verdicts with identified semantic or support defects. These are QA findings, not a measured overall error count; F02 retains a domain-common-knowledge exception boundary.

verification_only_findings.meaning: Primary no is supported, verifier yes is defective, and final consensus already preserves unknown.

primary_visual_findings.meaning: Specific missed layout/readability defects; these visual items had no independent second-model verification.

limits: All 14 final reports were inspected within a targeted scope; not all 130 pages were visually re-inspected and not every criterion was independently rescored.
Agreement between two isolated model calls is not proof of correctness; reported findings include shared misses.
Supported binary answers can still contain wrong page references, numerical descriptions, overlap objects or visibility claims.

Actual overlap, readability severity, chart interpretation and common-knowledge exceptions must not be collapsed into one error label. The 10/B timing-origin concern is retained as an interpretation gap rather than a high-confidence extra reversed verdict.
Findings do not create new human truth, measure general accuracy, justify a winner, or alter frozen results.

final_result.conclusion: Reproducible research version; known semantic construction and judgment defects remain. Human labels and raw model answers were not changed to fit rankings.

human_comparison_labels.usage: Offline score comparison only; separate historical human-reliability audit had already inspected development labels.
